description: This Java source file defines the BookService class, which provides business logic for managing Book entities in a book tracking application. It includes methods for CRUD operations, updating book details, and interacting with related entities like authors, publishers, and shelves.

classes.name: BookService
classes.description: Service class providing business logic for managing Book entities, including CRUD operations, updates, and interactions with related entities.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Book by its ID, returning an Optional containing the Book if found.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a Book entity after associating it with its author and publishers, returning an Optional of the saved Book.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of Book entities.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all Books.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves Books filtered by title containing the specified text.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified Book and potentially its author if the author has no other books.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all Books and Authors from the repository.

methods.name: getJsonRepresentationForBooksAsString
methods.description: Returns a JSON string representing all Books.

methods.name: findByShelfAndTitleOrAuthor
methods.description: Placeholder method intended to find Books by shelf, title, or author; currently throws NotImplementedException.

methods.name: findByTitleOrAuthor
methods.description: Placeholder method intended to find Books by title or author; currently throws NotImplementedException.

methods.name: findAllBooksByPredefinedShelfName
methods.description: Retrieves all Books associated with a specific predefined shelf name.

methods.name: updateBook
methods.description: Updates a Book's metadata, author, genres, and shelf based on a BookPatchDto.
